description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessTokenRepository class within the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to creation, persistence, revocation, and retrieval of OAuth access tokens, ensuring correct behavior and handling edge cases.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the AccessTokenRepository's functionality related to OAuth access tokens, including creation, revocation, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: testGetNewToken
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new access token with specified client details and verifies its properties and encryption.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenWithScopes
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new access token with scopes and verifies scope serialization.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Tests that calling getExpiryDateTime() on an uninitialized token throws an Error.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that calling getIdentifier() on an uninitialized token throws an Error.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that a new access token is correctly persisted into the database with proper data.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a token with a duplicate identifier throws a UniqueTokenIdentifierConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking an existing access token and verifies that its revoked state is updated.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that revoking an already revoked token maintains its revoked status.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that revoking a non-existent access token does not cause errors and is handled gracefully.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether the repository correctly reports the revoked status of known tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Tests behavior when checking revocation status of a token that does not exist; should return false.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of access tokens by token string returns correct entities or null if not found.
